processingFast.$description: Shortest simulated processing time in the Labs button completion experiment.

failureHold.$description: How long the Not published state holds before the button becomes a Try again action.

changeDuration.$description: Icon pop and label fade when the button changes state. The button width never changes.

shakeDistance.$description: Horizontal travel of the error shake.

enterDuration.$description: Send email version: the icon growing into a paper plane resting in the slingshot.

introTravel.$description: Send email version: how far the resting icon, label and description slide down as they fade on press.

aimDuration.$description: Send email version: the plane being drawn back in the slingshot before release.

slingExitDuration.$description: Send email version: the slingshot recoiling out through the left edge after launch.

expectedDuration.$description: Send email version: a typical send. The plane covers most of its arc in about this time while sending is pending, and keeps slowing if sending takes longer.

finishDuration.$description: Send email version: the pace for flying the rest of the arc (or dropping on failure) once the result is known, as a whole-arc duration.

resultBeatDuration.$description: Send email version: the pause after the plane leaves (or the crash burst fades) before the result mark draws.

markDuration.$description: Send email version: the checkmark or cross drawing itself on.

stageWidth.$description: Send email version: maximum width of the button (never wider than its container).

stageHeight.$description: Send email version: the fixed height of the button, including the bottom label row.

strokeWidth.$description: Send email version: slingshot frame, band and paper crease line width.
